# Arialief

> Arialief is a Nerve Health & Sciatic Comfort Supplement. Arialief is a dietary supplement formulated to ease everyday sciatic nerve discomfort and support overall nerve health. Taken as part of a daily routine, it aims to calm the nagging sensations that travel from the lower back through the hip and down the leg, while feeding the nervous system the nutritional support it needs to function comfortably. It is a capsule-based wellness product intended for adults dealing with occasional nerve-related discomfort, not a prescription painkiller or a medical treatment.
